name: @yass/desktop
description: Tray application: owns configuration behind native pickers and runs the YASS server as a child process
//: CommonJS on purpose, and only here. Electron preload scripts cannot be ESM under `sandbox: true`, and CJS sidesteps the app.whenReady()-vs-async-ESM ordering traps in main. The rest of the repo — including the server bundle this spawns — stays ESM.
//electron: Pinned, not ranged. electron-builder downloads the platform binaries for one exact release and refuses to guess from a range — and with npm workspaces hoisting electron to the repo root, it cannot read the installed version to resolve one either.
author: DevPrice
